"AVEVA Select" is the branding AVEVA uses for its network of regional reseller and systems-integrator partners, and this record most plausibly identifies an Italian partner office selling and supporting AVEVA's software products under that program, likely operating under the name "Factory Software" as the local reseller entity. A software reseller and integrator's office maintains its own business IT systems but is not a data-center operator; the telecom=data_center tag here is best read as a mistag of the office's own server or IT closet.

reading.body:
This record is a mistagged software reseller office in Italy, not a data center, and it carries zero megawatts of load.

The point is tagged telecom=data_center in OpenStreetMap, but the name resolves to an Italian office of AVEVA's regional reseller program, selling industrial engineering and operations software. A reseller's office runs its own business IT, which is the likely source of the tag. The facility has no operator, no website, and no capacity listed, and the profile states plainly that it is not a data-center operator.

For AI scaling this matters only as a data-quality signal. Inventories of data centers built from volunteered geographic data will contain points like this one, and any count of Italian facilities that includes it overstates the physical footprint. The zero megawatts is consistent with that: there is no power draw here to add to a grid total.

What the record does not tell the reader is anything about AVEVA's actual software, its customers, or where the compute behind those products runs. It also says nothing about Italy's real data-center capacity, because a single mistag is not evidence about the rest of the inventory. The nearest airport, Milan Malpensa at 1.2 miles, is the only geographic detail beyond the coordinates.
